expectedFunctionality: Calculate foreground/background WCAG relative-luminance contrast ratio and report the current AA normal, AA large and AAA normal thresholds.
observedFunctionality: The local engine computes contrastRatio from parsed colors and explicitly evaluates 4.5, 3 and 7 thresholds. Executable tests cover 21:1 black/white and a failing #777777-on-white AA-normal case; Gold/browser evidence records the public-route result.
rationale: The declared WCAG contrast-checking job is implemented and directly tested. Tickets 298-317 are image editing/export enhancements and do not constitute a gap in this current contrast calculator contract.

evidence.claim: Gold receipt binds contrast-checker to its oracle/fixtures and records a real-route contrast assertion of 21.
Executable tests call checkContrastLocal and verify both passing WCAG thresholds for black/white and failing AA-normal behavior for #777777 on white.
Expanded-local acceptance includes contrast-checker and verifies its real-route submitted output plus locality/mobile/lazy evidence.
The Gold receipt binds cand-151 and includes the W3C WCAG 2.2 truth source for the contrast thresholds used by the tool.
